question: How should libations be performed using white and black sesame seeds?
premises: Libations are to be offered in the same number as before.
One offering uses white sesame seeds.
A parallel offering uses black sesame seeds.
inference: One should offer libations of the same number with white sesame seeds and likewise with black sesame seeds.
plain_english: One should offer libations of the same number with white sesame seeds, and likewise with black sesame seeds.
